SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.title, p.images, p.tags, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount, p.collect_count AS collectCount, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.is_top AS isTop, p.hot_score AS hotScore, p.is_hot AS isHot, p.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM tb_post_collect c INNER JOIN tb_post p ON c.post_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 2 LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
